messages.subject: Moderation analysis
parts:
Hi!
My name is João and I'm learning to use lavaan.
Can I perform a moderation analysis using argument "group" in function "sem"? Does it make sense?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Moderation analysis
parts: Can I perform a moderation analysis using argument "group" in function "sem"? Does it make sense?

It can, if your grouping variable is the moderator.  Unless you explicitly constrain parameters across groups, then by default, every parameter can be moderated by group.  You can label the parameters to define Wald tests of differences across groups: see the ?lavTestWald help page.
